name: social-harness
description: Harness event-driven: señales de tendencia → relevancia por perfil → ideas, calendario y borradores (NestJS + BullMQ + dashboard web)

scripts.docker:infra:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infra.yml up -d postgres
scripts.docker:infra:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infra.yml stop postgres
scripts.docker:up:local: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infra.yml --profile fixture up -d --build
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts
